profileEvidence.author: C
profileEvidence.summary: Loyal and energetic, the Rampur Hound tends to be affectionate with its family and reserved with strangers. It combines an independent streak with a capacity to learn and respond to its owner. Known for fast running and endurance, this Indian hound also serves as a watchdog and has its home region around Rampur in Uttar Pradesh.
profileEvidence.shortDescription: Energetic and loyal, the Rampur Hound pairs a reserved welcome for strangers with Indian running and guarding traditions.
